_notes: Acute-care community hospital, Madera. CLOSED Jan 2023 after >$25M FY2022 loss; laid off 700+ employees. Trinity Health/Saint Agnes Medical Center acquisition collapsed Dec 2022 over Health Care Districts Law concerns. Ch 11 filed; bankruptcy plan with American Advanced Management (AAM) confirmed Feb 2024 (court declined UCSF-Adventist proposal); plan effective May 7 2024; reopening process began. CA Distressed Hospital Loan Program provided up to $52M. Standalone non-rated independent — closure event is the realized outcome.

moodys.citation_text: Not publicly rated by Moody's; standalone independent.

rating_actions_in_window.rationale: Closed January 2023 after >$25M FY2022 loss and collapsed Trinity/Saint Agnes acquisition. 700+ layoffs.
rating_actions_in_window.citation_text: Madera Community Hospital closed in January 2023 and laid off over 700 employees after sustaining losses of more than $25 million in 2022.
Madera Community Hospital Reopens After Emerging from Chapter 11 Bankruptcy with Help from Perkins Coie and the California Distressed Hospital Loan Program.

rating_actions_in_window.rationale: Bankruptcy court confirmed AAM reorganization plan over UCSF-Adventist proposal.
rating_actions_in_window.citation_text: Judge approves Madera Community Hospital reopening plan, declining proposal by UCSF Health, Adventist.

rating_actions_in_window.rationale: Plan effective May 7 2024; AAM took over and began reopening process.
rating_actions_in_window.citation_text: AAM agreed to take over management, pay reopening expenses, and contribute up to $31M to liquidation trust for projected 100% creditor recovery. The confirmed plan became effective on May 7, 2024.

outcome_class_rationale: Chapter 11 filing during window (calendar 2023). Although unrated by major agencies, the bankruptcy filing constitutes default-equivalent outcome under taxonomy. Key honesty-detector test case: did pre-2023 disclosure signal collapse?
